description: The Minstrel starts singing a song about Groo.
Groo joins a troop of travelling actors. He struggles with the difference between performance and reality.

issue_title: Groo and the Tale of King Sage
description: Sage hires Groo to guard the northernmost passage into his kingdom. Groo shares Sage's wisdom on his trip to the north.
Groo gets a job helping to build a pyramid.
Groo joins a monastery.
Groo is invited to lead Pescatel's army.

Groo's sister, Grooella, sends for his help with an upcoming attack. While travelling to her castle, he encounters an army and joins up in hopes of opportunities to fight and eat. He reminisces about his childhood with Grooella along the way. Upon arriving at the castle and learning of the situation, Groo suggests taking the offensive instead of waiting for the Cominos to attack and leads the entire army of Perudia out of the castle leaving it defenceless against the Cominos.
Groo assists his sister in her campaign to recapture her city from the Cominos.
Groo is sent to slay a dragon.
Groo ends the Siege of his sister's castle.

issue_title: Groo and the Witches of Brujas
description: Groo is enlisted by Arba and Dakarba to help them recover Dakarba's powers after she was stripped of them by Gravito the Sorcerer.
Groo crosses paths with Ambassador Gru.
Pal uses Drumm and Groo in a series of fixed bouts designed to bilk people out of their money.
Arcadio sends the Minstrel to seek Groo's help dispelling a curse that has been placed on Arcadio's town.

The city of Carpeta will not give Groo a job as a soldier as they already have two full garrisons. These garrisons are sufficient to repel two hordes of bandits simultaneously. Groo protects the village of Alfombra against a series of attacks by two different groups of bandits (one of which is lead by Taranto) that ultimately lead to the destruction of the city. The now homeless residents of Alfombra are forced to become bandits as well. Groo tells the three groups of bandits about the city of Carpeta's defences, and sets out to lead them to the city.
Arba and Dakarba summon Groo to help restore Dakarba's powers again.

The Minstrel and the Sage are mistaken for spies and captured. They tell two stories about Groo. In the first story, Groo is giving the job of spying on King Kohon's enemy. He brings back the wrong information. In the second story, Groo is dispatched as a messenger for King Kassabist. He succeeds in delivering the wrong message to the king's general and the armies of the king end up divided. Groo shows up at the camp where the Minstrel and the Sage are being held and is mocked by those who heard the stories. In the ensuing fray, the Minstrel and the Sage are able to slip away.

During a fray, Groo catches the scent of something delicious. He follows the smell to Alumerzo, where he discovers that it is coming from the king's kitchen. The king is the only person in the town who is well fed. He gets a job in the castle, but is only fed slop with the rest of the staff. Disappointed, he leaves in search of a better place to eat. In Merienda, he encounters a royal envoy that is search for a new chef for the king. They offer him a reward if he finds a great chef. After a fruitless search, Groo returns to Alumerzo and kidnaps the king's cook. The king of Merienda is pleased with the new cook and has him prepare a fabulous banquet for the king of Alumerzo, King Sopa. King Sopa offers his friendship to the king of Alumerzo and wishes to meet the cook. Upon discovering that it is his very own cook, King Sopa declares war on Merienda.
Groo meets Rufferto the dog.
Groo finds himself in the midst of two warring groups, the Melenitas and the Hetitas.
Groo's search for Rufferto's owner is derailed by an encounter with Taranto.
Pal and Drumm discover that Groo has money. They attempt to trick him into giving it to them.
Groo's riches attract many people looking for loans.
The town of Peralvillo offers Groo a reward to protect them from the Pirates of Salgari.

issue_title: The Amulet (in which we Finally Learn the Name of the Sage's Dog...)
description: Abra and Dakabra need Groo's help to find the other half of the Great Wizard's amulet.
Groo ends up with the amulet. All his wishes come true.
Groo uses the amulet to give his friends everything he thinks they want.
The threat of Groo's arrival has serious effects on the village of Miggledy well before he arrives.

Rufferto is kidnapped by men who recognize him and know of the reward offered for his return. The kidnapping happens after Groo sends the dog to the kitchen to be "served". Groo thinks he has eaten Rufferto and sees things that resemble the dog throughout the story. When Groo actually encounters Rufferto during a battle, he thinks it is his mind playing tricks on him and he runs back into the fray, leaving Rufferto in the hands of the kidnappers.
Groo tries to distract himself from missing Rufferto by getting work carrying people across a river. Pal and Drumm try to cash in on the reward offered for Rufferto.
Groo encounters a village where all the women have been kidnapped. He offers his assistance to get them back.

Groo is once again looking for work. He is directed to a nearby town by a woman he meets on a road. Upon his arrival, he discovers that there is a very long line of applicants looking to land the same job. Rufferto eats a bar of soap and imitates a rabid dog to get rid of the other applicants. While interviewing for the job, Groo breaks a glass carafe. The foreman asks Groo to replace it and if he does a good job, he's hired. He sets out on a quest to replace the carafe. After finding, and breaking, a number of replacement carafes, he finally gets back to town with an intact one to discover that the foreman had expected him to make a new one as the job he was applying for was at a glass works.
Groo is hired to rid a town of gypsies. He discovers Granny Groo among them and rides along with her. Interspersed with the story are flashbacks to Groo's childhood.
Granny Groo arranges for Groo to marry a farmer's daughter to collect the dowry, which she then uses to fit Groo out as a prince and tries to marry him to the Princess Latessa.

Granny Groo makes arrangements to sell Groo into slavery. Groo recalls a time when she sold him as a child with a promise to have him freed later. Rufferto is given Groo's swords to guard while Groo is with the slavers and tells a story of his bravery to a pack of wild dogs. Rufferto returns Groo's swords to him just as he is backed into a corner by a group of King Londo's guards.
Groo and his dog are shipwrecked on an island, where he proceeds to unintentionally destroy the ecosystem by introducing the concept of money.

Groo encounters Chinampa, and island-sized grouping of ships. Groo boards Chinampa, and is made its captain by its king. He accidentally makes good decisions and is well fed. Captain Ahax encounters and boards Chinampa, and Groo tells everyone Ahax is a great captain and defers to him. Between them they manage to beach Chinampa near land, making it an island and freeing the king to be rid of captains and allowing him to have total control of his domain.
This issue focuses on Groo's supporting cast. Groo does not appear.
Groo sets out on a quest to recover the Eye of Kabula.
Groo is hired to rescue King Caballo's horses back from Yegua, the horse thief. Moral: When you think for yourself, no one thinks for you...

Groo is hungry...but what else is new, but this time he might have found the prefect meal, his horse.

Moral: If you doubt a friend you are not being a friend.

The Gurus - Follow no False prophets who tell you things... Follow only Groo, he will tell you nothing, and you will save money!

This arc is wonderfully creative, as Sergio has always mastered, its also quite the crack up. Groo being his dumb self throughout the book and surprisingly, no one dies!!!!

Weaver and his Scribe are looking for the next great heroic tale, but they find Groo.

Moral: Even when words are true, they may not be the truth.

issue_title: The Scepter of King Cetro, Part 2
description:
Part two of three...We think

Groo has forgoten who Groo is, and whats worse Groo has forgotten where Groo had hidden the Scepter of King Cetro. Can Groo find it before Grooella and her attack him, who ever he is?
Weaver and Scribe have written a new book, but this one may get them killed and Groo maybe their only hope...They are doomed
The Sage tells the story of how Groo lost a young Princess Thaiis in the domain of the Peludos.
